issues.evidence: 'We use the following results from [StripCompanion, Theorem 1.1 and Lemmas 2.1, 2.3]'

main_claim: For every fixed loop fugacity chi>0, the critical honeycomb partition function Z_N(chi) of disjoint polygons separating two markers on the balanced cylinder satisfies Z_N = N^{tau(chi)+o(1)}, with tau = 1/6 - (2/(3pi^2)) arccos(chi/2)^2 for chi<=2 and the arcosh branch for chi>=2. Consequently planar nests satisfy P_chi(r) = r^{tau/2+o(1)} (so P_2 = r^{1/12}), middle-strip nesting S_k = k^{1/12}, and there are strip path-length exponents 13/12 (raw) and 4/3 (conditioned).
